title: BodyColorAttributeResistance
description: Per-color attribute resistance rules, keyed by color id. Parsed into BodyColorResistanceRule (lib/domain/master_data/body_color_resistance_rule.dart) — each key becomes colorId.

attributeResistanceBonuses.description: Maps an attribute id (see attributes.json) to the resistance bonus this color grants. Negative entries are automatically zeroed out when this color becomes an SP color, and a solo color with no entries here automatically grants +1 to every attribute.
